I also created the API route at `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` and a `.env` file. What blocked completion: I had to deviate from the docs because the documented CSS import path `@copilotkit/react-core/v2/styles.css` does not exist in the installed package; the actual file is `@copilotkit/react-core/dist/v2/index.css`. I was still editing `app/layout.tsx` and had not yet run `npm run dev` or verified the copilot endpoint when the session ended.
